settings.heading: Priced from what it actually costs
settings.subheading: The metal, the stones, and a margin we can defend. Never an invented list price to discount against.

settings.title: The more of us, the less it costs
settings.text: One design, one window. Every order drops the price for everyone — and you are never charged more than the price you joined at.

settings.title: One piece. One price. Then it is gone.
settings.text: Final sale, and we say so before you buy — never after.

settings.title: Have it made
settings.text: A $49 deposit starts the design. Nothing is produced until you approve it.

settings.title: Bring us a number
settings.text: A recent written custom quote gets our guarantee. Everything else we will still read honestly.

settings.heading: Every route to the same thing: a price that makes sense

settings.statement: We will tell you exactly what you are getting

settings.heading: Pay by bank, pay less
settings.text:
Paying by bank costs us less to accept, so we pass it through rather than keeping it. Zelle or domestic wire.

You see both prices before you commit, and the exact dollar saving on every piece.

settings.heading: Inspected here. Covered for a year.
settings.text:
Every piece is checked by us before it ships, so the first person to find a problem is us and not you.

Tracked and insured in transit, signature required over $100, and a one-year limited warranty against manufacturing faults — handled by the same company that sold it to you.

settings.statement: Better value, better protection, a better way to buy
